name: Project Explorer Menus
summary: Adds commands to the right-click menu of the open file — starter skeleton built on the SDK (docs/97)
description:
A starter extension for growing the right-click menu of the open file.
Step 1 (this version): a 'Project Explorer Menus' submenu in the editor context menu with one command, Show file path, which asks the host for the active document's path (nx_host_get / Editor::doc_path) and writes it to the app log (developer mode, ext layer).
Next steps are listed in docs/97: attaching the menu to the Project Explorer OPEN FILES rows, file operations, and settings under ext.project_explorer_menus.*.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Project Explorer Menus is on — right-click in an editor: Project Explorer Menus > Show file path (log window shows the path).
